verdict.rationale: Square documents online card payments through its Payments API card-payments docs, the Web Payments SDK, and prebuilt eCommerce connections it says can be completed in a few clicks. Personal access tokens are also documented as usable in production for your own account. However, nothing in the evidence addresses signup-to-first-live-payment time, so the 'within a day' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented onboarding or account-activation timeline, evidence of same-day first live payment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Process payments on Square hardware or online using any Internet-connected device.
Square has prebuilt online payment solutions with top eCommerce providers. Most connections can be completed in just a few clicks.
For custom integrations that only access your own Square account, personal access tokens are suitable for production use.
